tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: For the Assessment Year 2017-18 and 2018-19, the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) has allowed our appeal and upheld the CIT(A) order deleting the penalty amounting to Rs. 1.41 Crore and Rs. 2.49 Crore

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Assistant Commissioner of GST, Kerala had during the period 2017-18 raised a demand of Rs. 0.72 Crore including Tax Rs. 0.34 Crore, Interest Rs. 0.35 Crore and Penalty Rs. 0.03 Crore, on account of disallowance of Transitional GST Credit. The Company had filed an Appeal before the Joint Commissioner on March 1, 2024. The Joint Commissioner has partly allowed the Company’s appeal, reducing the tax demand from Rs. 0.34 crores to Rs. 0.12 crores. The interest and penalty demand of Rs. 0.38 crores was subsequently reduced to Rs. 0.14 crores. Further, to avail the GST Amnesty Scheme 2024, as per CGST Notification No. 21/2024, the Company paid the said tax component of Rs.0.12 crore and has filed an application for seeking waiver of the interest and penalty amounting to Rs.0.14 crore.
tax_litigation.status: The Deputy Commissioner at Thrissur, Kerala vide Order dated 24.11.2025 has waived off the interest and penalty amounting to Rs.0.14 cr as per GST Amnesty Scheme 2024

The Sales Tax Authority, West Bengal, raised a demand of Rs.2.35 crore for the financial year 2006–07 vide order dated 30.09.2009, primarily on account of disallowance of input tax credit, exempted sales, and other related matters. Aggrieved by the said demand, the Company duly preferred an appeal before the Additional Commissioner on 28.10.2009, which was disposed of vide order dated 25.11.2010. Thereafter, the Company filed a revision application before the Revision Board on 28.04.2011, which remained pending for disposal. During the pendency of the aforesaid proceedings, the Government of West Bengal introduced the Settlement of Dispute (SOD) Scheme vide Trade Circular dated 04.08.2025, providing an opportunity for resolution of legacy disputes upon payment of 15% of the disputed demand. Availing the benefit of the said Scheme and with a view to achieving finality in the matter, the Company filed an application under the SOD Scheme on 24.09.2025. Pursuant thereto, the Company duly paid a sum of Rs.0.35 crore, being 15% of the disputed tax demand. The application filed under the SOD Scheme has been accepted, and an intimation confirming settlement of the tax arrears has been received vide SOD Order dated 06.11.2025.

Input Tax Credit (ITC) for the Financial Year (FY) 2021-22 is disallowed by the GST Authorities, Bihar and a demand of Rs. 0.08 Crore was raised including interest Rs.0.03 Crores. The Company has preferred an appeal before the Additional Commissioner of GST during the quarter. The same is pending for disposal.

tax_litigation.status: The sales tax authority, Bihar, had raised a demand of Rs.3.45 crore for the F.Y.2006-07 vide order dated 21.03.2007 on account of VAT classification issue. Aggrieved by the said order, the Company preferred an appeal before Commissioner and Commercial Taxes Tribunal, Patna (Tribunal) who held against the company . Aggrieved by the said order the company filed an appeal before the Patna High Court. The Hon'ble Patna High Court vide Order dated 14.09.2023 had remanded the case back to the Tribunal to relook into the classification issue. The Tribunal, vide order dated 19.12.2025, allowed our appeal and held that the product in question is rightly classified by the assessee and taxed at correct applicable VAT rate. The said order was physically received on 02.02.2026.

tax_litigation.status: For A.Y. 2013–14, the Hon’ble Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), vide its order dated 17.09.2026, dismissed the appeal filed by the Income Tax Department on the ground of territorial jurisdiction. Consequently, the order of the CIT(A), allowing sales promotion expenses and Transfer Pricing adjustments amounting to Rs.53.21 crore, remains undisturbed. The ITAT, however, granted liberty to the Income Tax Department to file an appeal before the appropriate Bench of the ITAT.
